item.title: Elderly, Disabled Have Jan. 15 Deadline For New Tax Credit
item.description: Blind and disabled Hoosiers and seniors should apply for property tax credits by Jan. 15, 2026 to ensure they receive the benefits they are due.

item.title: Bobbi Burkhart Announces Bid for Kosciusko County Assessor
item.description: Bobbi Burkhart announced that she is running for Kosciusko County Assessor.

item.title: Van Buren Township Holds First Meeting Of The Year
item.description: The Van Buren Township Advisory approved increases in food pantry assistance, cemetery maintenance and several other ordinances at its first meeting of the year Tuesday, Jan. 6.

item.title: Syracuse Eagles Raise Funds For Crohn’s and Colitis Foundation
item.description: The Syracuse Eagles 3760 held its fourth annual fundraising event for the Crohn’s and Colitis Foundation on Dec. 13.

item.title: Free Bridal Showcase At Center Lake Pavilion Jan. 10
item.description: A new kind of bridal event is coming to Kosciusko County this month as Columbia City Bridal hosts the Wedding Edit 1-4 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 10 at Center Lake Pavilion.

item.title: Local Leaders Register for Primary Election
item.description: Filing for the 2026 primary election opened 8 a.m. Wednesday, Jan. 7.

item.title: Tippy-Chapman Sewer District To Meet Monday, Jan. 12
item.description: The Board of Trustees of the Tippecanoe and Chapman Regional Sewer District will hold its monthly meeting at 6:30 p.m. Monday, Jan. 12, at the North Webster Community Center, 301 N. Main St., North Webster.

item.title: Fellowship Missions’ Petition to Rezone Former All Things New Location Approved by APC
item.description: Fellowship Missions’ petition to rezone 20 acres on the west side of Warsaw from an agricultural district to a residential district was approved during a Wednesday, Jan. 7, Area Plan Commission meeting.

item.title: Vacation of Alleyways in Wooster Cause Concern
item.description: The request of a vacation of alleyways in Wooster caused concern among those in attendance at the Area Planning Commission Meeting on Wednesday, Jan. 7.
